steps.title:
HOOP SHOOT
LEAGUE
steps.body: Shoot hoops, win your league, earn new courts & extras, master the online leaderboard. Play for keeps.

steps.title: DOWN HERE..
steps.body: You'll find the area's league, along with time trial and practice mode. Compete in league mode to increase your level and unlock new areas.

steps.title: UP HERE..
steps.body: Is where you can see your current level & tickets, access your locker and settings.

steps.title: PLAY ONLINE
steps.body: Check the rankings and challenge other players head to head.

steps.title: TOP 5
steps.body: The best time trial scores in this area. Tap the list to see the full board.

steps.title: THAT'S IT!
steps.body: You're all set. Now get shooting.

steps.title: {LEAGUE}
steps.body: Matches are {SECONDS}-second heats against shooters from the {AREA}. Play a {GAMES}-game season, finish in the top {TOP} to make the playoffs, and win it all for the title. Every heat earns XP and tickets.

steps.title: THE TABS
steps.body: Everything about your league lives in these five tabs.

steps.title: MATCH
steps.body: Your next heat: who you're facing, the cards they own, and PLAY to tip off.

steps.title: TABLE
steps.body: The season standings. Finish in the top {TOP} to make the playoffs.

steps.title: SCHED
steps.body: Every heat this season, the ones you have played and the ones still to come.

steps.title: CARDS
steps.body: Power-up cards. Buy them in the shop with tickets, then arm up to 3 before each heat.

steps.title: STATS
steps.body: Your season and career numbers: record, points per game, best heats and titles.

steps.title: GOOD LUCK!
steps.body: Tap PLAY on the MATCH tab when you're ready.

steps.title: FREE PLAY!
steps.body: Nice first game! Here's a free play on PEGGY, the prize machine.

steps.title: THIS IS PEGGY
steps.body: Spend tickets here to win rewards: new balls, nets and more.

steps.title: THE PRIZES
steps.body: Your puck lands in one of these slots. The dot is its rarity: blue common, green rare, pink epic. Level up to unlock rarer prizes.

steps.title: ON THE HOUSE
steps.body: This one is free. After that, each play costs {COST} tickets. Tap PLAY, steer with the stick and hit DROP. Your prizes go to the LOCKER, where you can view and equip them.
